title: Boku dake ga Inai Machi

synonyms: The Town Where Only I am Missing

synopsis:
When tragedy is about to strike, Satoru Fujinuma finds himself sent back several minutes before the accident occurs. The detached, 29-year-old manga artist has taken advantage of this powerful yet mysterious phenomenon, which he calls "Revival," to save many lives.
 
However, when he is wrongfully accused of murdering someone close to him, Satoru is sent back to the past once again, but this time to 1988, 18 years in the past. Soon, he realizes that the murder may be connected to the abduction and killing of one of his classmates, the solitary and mysterious Kayo Hinazuki, that took place when he was a child. This is his chance to make things right.
 
Boku dake ga Inai Machi follows Satoru in his mission to uncover what truly transpired 18 years ago and prevent the death of his classmate while protecting those he cares about in the present.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
synopsis_es:
Cuando la tragedia está a punto de ocurrir, Satoru Fujinuma se ve enviado de regreso varios minutos antes de que ocurra el accidente. El indiferente artista de manga de 29 años ha aprovechado este fenómeno poderoso pero misterioso, al que llama "Revival", para salvar muchas vidas.
 
Sin embargo, cuando es acusado injustamente de asesinar a alguien cercano a él, Satoru es enviado de regreso al pasado una vez más, pero esta vez a 1988, 18 años atrás. Pronto, se da cuenta de que el asesinato puede estar relacionado con el secuestro y asesinato de uno de sus compañeros de clase, el solitario y misterioso Kayo Hinazuki, que tuvo lugar cuando él era un niño. Esta es su oportunidad de hacer las cosas bien.
 
Boku dake ga Inai Machi sigue a Satoru en su misión de descubrir lo que realmente sucedió hace 18 años y evitar la muerte de su compañero de clase mientras protege a sus seres queridos en el presente.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]
background:
Boku dake ga Inai Machi is based on Kei Sanbe's manga series of the same title. The anime adapts the full story of the manga, though it condenses and alters the events that take place in volumes 6 to 8.

The first two episodes were shown at an event on January 5, 2016, at Shinjuku Ward 9. A live-action movie adaptation was released in Japan on March 19, 2016 which also featured an alternate ending. A live-action Netflix TV series was released on December 15, 2017.

episodes_data.title: Flashing Before My Eyes
episodes_data.description: Satoru Fujinuma is a struggling manga artist who works at a pizza parlor. Ever since he was a kid, he has been holding himself responsible for a kidnapping incident. Finally, the time has come for the truth from his past to be revealed…

episodes_data.title: Palm of the Hand
episodes_data.description: The year is 1988… Satoru is back in elementary school. Now, he has a chance to change the future!

episodes_data.title: Birthmark
episodes_data.description: Satoru is determined to prevent Kayo from getting kidnapped before her birthday. He goes to her place to see her, but… is he too late?

episodes_data.title: Accomplishment
episodes_data.description: Satoru invites Hinazuki to the Science Center so she won’t be alone. He suspects that he’s riding the same pre-Revival rail of time, and before he knows it, X-day has arrived...

episodes_data.title: Getaway
episodes_data.description: It turns out that Kayo, absent from school, has disappeared after all. Satoru is tormenting himself with the thought that he should have been able to do something more. On top of that, Aya Nakanishi from the nearby elementary school has vanished too!

episodes_data.title: Grim Reaper
episodes_data.description: After confirming that the fire at Airi’s home is related to his mother’s death, Satoru relies on a note she left behind to make contact with Sawada, a former reporter for TV Ishikari...

episodes_data.title: Out of Control
episodes_data.description: After getting caught by the police, Satoru has only one wish… to have one final Revival to make things right!

episodes_data.title: Spiral
episodes_data.description: Instead of going home, Kayo has spent the last few days in a disused school bus while being supported by Satoru and the others. Only Sachiko and Yashiro begin to realize that something is going on when they observe changes in Satoru’s behavior.

episodes_data.title: Closure
episodes_data.description: After being "missing" for three days, Kayo returns home. Her mother, Akemi, sees Satoru and Sachiko standing a few paces behind... Will Kayo be safe at last?

episodes_data.title: Joy
episodes_data.description: Three people, including Hiromi, were murdered the first time around, but this time, the targets were moved out of the killer’s sights. However, Satoru is worried about whom the killer will go after next in place of his intended victims.

episodes_data.title: Future
episodes_data.description: After revealing who he really is, the kidnapper leaves Satoru to drown… Is it all over for Satoru?

episodes_data.title: Treasure
episodes_data.description: Finally Satoru regains his memories and faces off against the culprit!
